behaviorGroups.name: Heartbeat
behaviorGroups.realSurface: agent identity, inbox-lite, heartbeat context, budget and active-issue services
behaviorGroups.prpEvidence: runner/session/run context plus bounded task-context tool results
behaviorGroups.gap: Production semantic binding is unbound; identity and work selection remain injected/control-plane-owned.

behaviorGroups.name: Checkout
behaviorGroups.prpEvidence: run preparation and issue-status decision evidence with checkout receipt
behaviorGroups.gap: Intentionally no model tool; the production checkout receipt still needs the additive semantic-receipt envelope.

behaviorGroups.name: Status
behaviorGroups.realSurface: issue PATCH, review/liveness policy, and native finalization arbitration
behaviorGroups.prpEvidence: semantic operation receipt, work assessment, issue-status decision, and terminal causality
behaviorGroups.gap: Production semantic binding and additive typed operation/conflict receipts remain unimplemented.

behaviorGroups.name: Comments
behaviorGroups.prpEvidence: bounded read result or idempotent comment-write receipt plus audit reference
behaviorGroups.gap: Active-task binding is unbound; cross-task comment mutation is deliberately outside V1.

behaviorGroups.name: Search
behaviorGroups.realSurface: company issue search and agent/project/goal list/get routes
behaviorGroups.prpEvidence: bounded redacted read projections through tool-result item events
behaviorGroups.gap: Project and goal operations are scenario-only; every real service binding is unbound.

behaviorGroups.name: Subtasks
behaviorGroups.realSurface: company issue create, child issue, assignment, and wake services
behaviorGroups.prpEvidence: company/task state diff, audit reference, and continuation wake evidence
behaviorGroups.gap: create_task is production-bound to ordinary active-issue child creation with assignment, dependency-ready wake, company checks, child limits, and durable source-scoped idempotency.

behaviorGroups.name: Blockers
behaviorGroups.realSurface: issue relations, blocker projection, liveness validation, and blocker wake services
behaviorGroups.prpEvidence: dependency diff, block receipt, attention routing, and issue-status decision
behaviorGroups.gap: set_dependencies is production-bound for the active issue; block_task remains unbound, and cancelled-blocker receipts still need typed additive evidence.

behaviorGroups.name: Documents and plans
behaviorGroups.owner: always tools; restore optional; destructive lifecycle control-plane-only
behaviorGroups.prpEvidence: bounded reads and revision-safe write/conflict/denial receipts with revision lineage
behaviorGroups.gap: restore_document_revision is an approved optional-tool gap; lock/unlock/delete are intentionally control-plane-only.

behaviorGroups.name: Interactions
behaviorGroups.gap: Production binding and semantic resolution receipts are unbound.

behaviorGroups.name: Approvals
behaviorGroups.realSurface: company approval, decision, issue-link, comment, and governed-action services
behaviorGroups.prpEvidence: governed semantic receipts, audit references, and attention/continuation linkage
behaviorGroups.gap: Production binding and additive governed-action receipts are unbound; board-only authority stays outside grants.

behaviorGroups.name: Artifacts
behaviorGroups.realSurface: attachment upload and issue work-product routes
behaviorGroups.prpEvidence: artifact/work-product reference and durable inspectability receipt; never binary bytes
behaviorGroups.gap: Production upload/register composite and additive durable-reference receipt are unbound.

behaviorGroups.name: Errors and critical rules
behaviorGroups.realSurface: workspace runtime, monitor/recovery, budget, run persistence/replay, release, and terminal services
behaviorGroups.prpEvidence: runtime/workspace/attention/run lifecycle, typed denials, replay facts, and terminal causality
behaviorGroups.gap: Budget stop reasons and semantic denial/conflict receipts require additive v1 envelopes; inspect_operation_result remains scenario-only.

behaviorGroups.name: Reference files
behaviorGroups.owner: optional domain tools + test-only escape hatch
behaviorGroups.realSurface: case, routine, company-skill, secret, portability, and administration services
behaviorGroups.prpEvidence: bounded domain projections, redacted broker receipts, company diffs, and audit references
behaviorGroups.gap: These operations are scenario-only except generic_api_request, which is test-only; broad administer_company is deferred and cannot claim product coverage.

behaviorGroups.name: Multi-hop
behaviorGroups.realSurface: delegation, dependency, interaction, approval, artifact, and terminal orchestration services
behaviorGroups.prpEvidence: correlated operation receipts, state diffs, attention hops, work assessment, status decision, and terminal outcome
behaviorGroups.gap: No generic transaction tool is allowed; shared mock/real conformance must prove each composed effect.

behaviorGroups.name: Restraint and no-call
behaviorGroups.realSurface: task-mode, secret-broker, test-scope, pause, and budget policy checks
behaviorGroups.prpEvidence: absence of forbidden effects plus typed policy denial/redaction receipts when a call is attempted
behaviorGroups.gap: Typed redaction/authorization receipts need additive v1 evidence; generic_api_request is never a product fallback.

behaviorGroups.name: Wake situations
behaviorGroups.realSurface: wakeup requests, heartbeat context, comment/interaction/approval/blocker wake routing, and scheduled wake services
behaviorGroups.prpEvidence: attention request routing/resolution plus resumed session/run causality
behaviorGroups.gap: Production scheduling binding is unbound; control-plane routing remains non-callable.

companyAuthorization: Every entity read and write is resolved inside the authenticated actor's company; cross-company identifiers fail without disclosing protected facts.

Board actors use active membership and role permissions. Agent writes require a company-scoped run JWT and X-Paperclip-Run-Id; active-task tools cannot accept a caller-selected company or arbitrary task.

Optional tools are omitted unless every required claim, role, and task-mode condition is satisfied. A grant never bypasses approval, budget, pause, execution-lock, interaction-owner, or other governed-action checks.
taskModes: standard permits the full eligible catalog subject to claims and role checks.
ask is answer-only: investigation reads are eligible, while implementation, document mutation, delegation, terminal, and governed writes are absent.

planning permits plan/document/progress/input operations but not delegation or terminal completion; accepting a plan transitions the issue into a fresh standard execution continuation for the exact accepted revision.
skill_test exposes only scenario-admitted tools. generic_api_request additionally requires the explicit test grant and allowlist and never supplies product coverage.
redaction: Tool descriptors declare observable redaction. Secret plaintext may reach only the model-use capsule authorized for a bound secret; it never reaches PRP, logs, artifacts, errors, audit details, or serialized tool results.
Authorization denials reveal stable codes, missing public claims, and remediation only; they do not include protected entity state, credentials, headers, cookies, or another company's policy.
Artifacts carry durable references, hashes, content type, and size on the wire; binary payloads remain in storage transports.
idempotency: Every mutation whose descriptor says required must carry a stable idempotency key. Retrying the same key and equivalent input returns the prior receipt without duplicating side effects.
Reusing a key with different input is an idempotency conflict. Optimistic document writes additionally bind baseRevisionId and return the current revision on conflict.
PRP source event IDs are idempotent, source sequence gaps are evidence, and replay is side-effect free. Replaying a trace cannot repeat control-plane writes.
sideEffects: read operations return bounded projections and do not mutate control-plane state.
task_write and company_write operations emit normalized state diffs and immutable audit references after production authorization succeeds.
governance, workspace_control, secret_read, and admin operations retain their production-specific gates; catalog exposure is necessary but never sufficient authority.
Terminal semantic operations propose intent. The control plane owns checkout, release, budget enforcement, persisted run evidence, replay, wake routing, audit append, and final status arbitration.

scope: Issue documents are active-task working records identified by (activeIssueId, key). Always-present document tools do not accept a company id or arbitrary issue id.
Cross-task document reads require a future explicit optional operation and grant; case documents and future company knowledge are separate resource types.
Locked-document fallback may create a deterministic new key only when lockedDocumentStrategy is create_new_document; the source stays locked and the returned receipt names the redirected key.

operations.contract: baseRevisionId is null; create revision 1 and return document/revision/audit identity.
List metadata or read the current active-task document by stable key.
Require the exact latest baseRevisionId and an idempotency key; append an immutable revision.
Return bounded immutable revision history newest first.
Validate same-document lineage, reject locked documents, append a new revision, and return source/new revision identity; restoring current is a no-change duplicate.
Board/administrative lifecycle action; agent writes receive document_locked or use explicit create-new fallback.
Board/administrative lifecycle action; never inferred from a failed write.
Destructive audited action; pending targets become stale and the runner never recreates them automatically.

runner_work_selection.reason: Inbox selection belongs to the control plane.
